questions.question: How many slices represent durations that, when combined, exceed 50% of the total chart?
questions.feedback: This is a simple pie chart with few slices. Do not ask trivial questions like how many slices exceed 50% or how many are a certain color. Instead ask conditional counting that requires reading values: e.g. how many slices have percentage values that combined exceed a threshold, or how many slices represent durations within a specific range requiring careful reading.

questions.question: What is the ratio of the time spent on 'Reduction' to the time spent on 'Efficient deployment'?
If the time spent on 'Efficient deployment' were increased by 10 seconds, would it surpass the time spent on 'Reduction'?
Does the distribution of the pie chart segments suggest a dominance pattern, and if so, which segment dominates?
